title: Effectiveness of a compassion‐based positive psychology group intervention for cardiac recovery: A multiple‐baseline single‐case experimental design study
abstract: Abstract Background Patients with cardiovascular disease (CVD) commonly experience mental health problems. This study aimed to evaluate the effectiveness of a group‐based compassion‐based positive psychology intervention (CB‐PPI) in patients with CVD. Methods A multiple‐baseline single‐case experimental design with three phases (baseline, intervention, follow‐up) was used to examine the effectiveness of an eight‐week group CB‐PPI. Twelve participants completed weekly assessments of psychological wellbeing, anxiety symptoms, depressive symptoms, adaptive capacity, and positive skills. Multilevel analyses were conducted to compare outcomes during the intervention and follow‐up phases with the baseline phase. In addition, participants completed comprehensive questionnaires at baseline, post‐intervention, and two‐month follow‐up. Reliable changes and Wilcoxon signed‐rank tests were conducted. Results Compared with the baseline phase, significant improvements in weekly assessments were observed during the follow‐up phase for depressive symptoms, adaptive capacity, and positive skills. No significant effects were observed for anxiety symptoms and psychological wellbeing, and no significant differences were found between the baseline and intervention phases. Significant improvements in overall, emotional, and psychological wellbeing were found from pre‐ to post‐intervention, as well as in positive reframing and savouring. Psychological wellbeing significantly improved from pre‐ to two‐month follow‐up. Discussion This study provides preliminary evidence that a group‐based CB‐PPI may support patients with CVD in developing positive skills, enhance adaptive capacity, and improve wellbeing and depressive symptoms, although results are inconsistent across methods. However, more research is needed to confirm these findings, examine mechanisms of change, and establish the clinical utility of CB‐PPI in cardiovascular care.
